notes.title: Cyberpunk Bar Sim Update 16
notes.notes:
Hello Everyone!

We’ve been adding and improving/modifying a lot of features the past month, which includes a LOT of cleaning up of the code, environment, and game objects. We won’t be going over every change we’ve made, but we have also been incorporating new features as well.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33066823/5f26e18f302904e1cef79fb6cec8292dcdc40ad9.png

We’ve finished implementing the new bar environment into gameplay, which is unlocked via upgrading the bar and unlocking the second floor. It will open up many more customization and dialogue opportunities, in addition to allowing you to serve more customers. 

You can read more about this update here:
https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/cyberpunkbar/cyberpunk-bar-sim-a-sci-fi-tycoon-game/posts/2750520
